summary: Frontend-only verification of the FMP Packet build order + required-docs + approval blocker UX on /claims as admin usvopp@yahoo.com. 7/7 assertions passed on 3 ZZTEST packets (02/01/2026 approved+complete, ZZTEST packet 2 Smoke 01/06/2026 missing docs, ZZTEST Order 02/02/2026 draft+complete) plus reorder-persistence and ES toggle. Fixed cover-sheet row [data-testid=claim-item-cover-sheet] is always the first <tr> in the items table (verified first child of tbody) and shows 'Cover Sheet / FMP Claim Cover Sheet (generated automatically) / Always first'. The [data-testid=claim-required-docs-card] renders five badges with ✓/✗ (required-doc-va_disability_letter, required-doc-invoice, required-doc-progress_note, required-doc-provider_exequatur, required-doc-provider_diploma). On the 1-item Smoke packet 4 badges show ✗ and [data-testid=claim-approval-blockers] lists 4 'Missing required document: …' reasons; the [data-testid=claim-approve-btn] is rendered and disabled. On the fully-complete unapproved ZZTEST Order packet all 5 badges are ✓, no blockers element, approve btn enabled; clicking it flipped status Draft → Complete with [data-testid=claim-approval-info]='Approved · Approved by CEO · 10/13/2026' and the approve btn disappeared. Reorder via claim-item-up-{id} shuffled attached rows (cover stayed pinned first); after navigating back to list and re-opening the packet the new order was persisted. Spanish toggle via [data-testid=lang-toggle] re-rendered cover row as 'Portada / Portada del Reclamo FMP (generada automáticamente) / Siempre primero' and card header as 'Documentos requeridos para aprobar' with all 5 badges localized (Carta de Desglose de Discapacidad VA, Factura, Nota de Progreso Firmada y Completada, Exequátur del Proveedor, Diploma del Proveedor). No non-ZZTEST patients were touched. Send/email was never clicked.

integration_issues.issue: Repeated console errors 'load hidden options failed AxiosError: Request failed with status code 401' persist from iterations 43/44 — non-blocking, page renders.

critical_code_review_comments: Claims.js approve btn correctly uses disabled={ (approval_blockers||[]).length>0 || validation.status==='blocked' } and hides itself after approved — matches spec.
Fixed cover-sheet <tr data-testid='claim-item-cover-sheet'> is unconditionally the first child of <tbody> before the mapped items.map, so merged PDF order is enforced visually as well.

Required docs card iterates the exact 5-category list in spec order (va_disability_letter, invoice, progress_note, provider_exequatur, provider_diploma); matches backend FMP_DEFAULT_ORDER after cover.

The lang-toggle button exists in the main Layout (data-testid='lang-toggle'), not the per-page 'ES' text in the top bar which is a role-select icon; tests should always target [data-testid='lang-toggle'] to toggle i18n.
